title: Interdimensional portal in Secret Canyon

tellings.quote: And more importantly, there's a place called Secret Canyon where there's allegedly a portal. Some kind of interdimensional portal.

plain: A journalist named Ross Coulthart, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels in 2025, says there is a place called Secret Canyon near Sedona, Arizona, where people claim there is a portal. He describes it as some kind of interdimensional portal, meaning a doorway to another dimension, and raises it as part of his search for a hidden UFO base in the area.
